cohort: 401 patients with singleton pregnancies induced at ≥36 0/7 gestational weeks
finding: While MVI induced labor faster than OM, it was associated with a significantly higher rate of fetal heart rate changes and cesarean sections, although neonatal outcomes did not differ between groups.
mod_finding: The cesarean section rate was significantly higher in the MVI group (21.7%) versus the OM group (14.6%).
